The WyreStorm MX-0404-HDMI is a powerful plug and play matrix switcher, bundled in a small compact chassis for ease of installation. An 18Gbps matrix switcher, it allows up to four 4K sources to be independently routed to four displays. Additionally, each output has the capability to scale 4K content down to connected 1080p displays without affecting 4K sources. Audio following the output can be extracted via the digital 5.1 S/PDIF, allowing it to be sent to an external audio distribution system.
This small, yet robust 18Gbps HDMI switch comes fully equipped to fit in a standard 19” rack space, designed with professional installations in mind.

Bigger isn’t always better. The MX-0404-HDMI was designed with professional installations in mind. Because of its small chassis, the MX-0404-HDMI is a breeze to install, and with the included brackets, it can also be integrated into a standard 1U rack space making the MX-0404-HDMI a robust matrix for its size.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm MX-0404-HDMI is a powerful plug and play matrix switcher, bundled in a small compact chassis for ease of installation. An 18Gbps matrix switcher, it allows up to four 4K sources to be independently routed to four displays. Additionally, each output has the capability to scale 4K content down to connected 1080p displays without affecting 4K sources. Audio following the output can be extracted via the digital 5.1 S/PDIF, allowing it to be sent to an external audio distribution system.
This small, yet robust 18Gbps HDMI switch comes fully equipped to fit in a standard 19” rack space, designed with professional installations in mind.
Each output is built with an effective 4K to 1080p downscaler, allowing a mix of 4K and 1080p screens to show at their highest potential without affecting 4K sources.

Bigger isn’t always better. The MX-0404-HDMI was designed with professional installations in mind. Because of its small chassis, the MX-0404-HDMI is a breeze to install, and with the included brackets, it can also be integrated into a standard 1U rack space making the MX-0404-HDMI a robust matrix for its size.

Sporting a pure 18Gbps HDMI backplane, supporting all UHD video signals up to and including 2160p 4:4:4/60, and high frame-rate HDR 12bit 4:2:2 up to 60Hz, along with multichannel audio up to DTS:X and Dolby Atmos.

The MX-0808-SCL is a sophisticated HDMI matrix switcher designed for fast Seamless switching. Perfectly suited for professional environments such as corporate training rooms, hotel meeting spaces, and academic classrooms, this device boasts an integrated 4K60 scaler on each HDMI output, scaling from 480p to 2160p. Additionally, it features a comprehensive USB-C input . delivering support for 4K60 video, a 1GbE passthrough network connection, and PD3.0 USB host charging up to 60 watts, ensuring compatibility and ease of use across a variety of devices and setups.

Seamless fast switching up to 4K60 across all video inputs and outputs with less than 50ms delay. Provides a smooth, instantaneous transition between video sources without any noticeable lag or interruption. Enhancing the viewer experience in professional and entertainment settings, ensuring high-quality presentations and displays without disruptions.

Features like automatic video input and output detection, and built-in scalers on each output, enable the matrix to deliver high-quality video tailored to the resolution of each connected display, ensuring the best possible image quality across all screens.

With support for de-embedded audio from HDMI inputs to balanced output ports, this feature enables precise audio routing completely independent of video signals. This flexibility allows for the creation of customized audio experiences tailored to the unique needs of your space.

Video Wall and Multiview Support

The MX-0812-SCL is an HDMI matrix switcher featuring 8 HDMI inputs and 12 outputs, each capable of handling 4K60 video, with advanced scaling for each output. It includes video processing capabilities for video walls, such as cropping and bezel correction, as well as multiview options like Picture-in-Picture and Quad view. Designed for various applications, it offers seamless switching, video wall control, and multiview functions (coming in an update), alongside comprehensive audio support through HDMI de-embedding, analog, and Dante audio connections.

Featuring video wall processing capabilities, including cropping, bezel correction, scaling, and the ability to rotate images by 90, 180, or 270 degrees (Outputs 9-12). Additionally, it supports grouping functions for enhanced video wall presentations. The matrix also offers sophisticated multiview capabilities, supporting the simultaneous display of up to four separate video sources on a single screen. When activated, the multiview configuration is mirrored across HDMI outputs 1 to 4, ensuring consistent visual outputs on multiple displays. It supports a variety of multiview layouts, including Picture-in-Picture (PIP), Picture-by-Picture (PBP), Split Screen, Master view, and Quad view, catering to different viewing preferences and requirements. This flexibility makes it ideal for scenarios requiring real-time monitoring of multiple video feeds, such as control rooms, live events, and professional broadcasting environments.

The Matrix provides three distinct working modes tailored for system integrator projects: seamless matrix switching, video wall controller, and multiview switcher. This versatility makes it well-suited for a variety of applications and user needs. featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Working automatically on signal presence or triggered via the API, the MXV 6x6 can send power trigger commands to all compatible connected screens or projectors meaning an integrated autonomous control solution

In addition to the audio breakout ports, the MXV 6x6 also features four HDMI mirrored output ports which can be paired with any of WyreStorm's HAOC hybrid optical HDMI cables for transmission up to 50m/164ft or any extender for transmission of HDBaseT or OM3 fiber.
4K HDR HDBaseT 6x6 Matrix Switch, supporting:
Proprietory compression algorithm enables 60Hz 4K UHD content (4:4:4 or HDR) to be sent over HDBaseT to 35m/115ft
Compatible with DVI-I and DP++ v1.3 signals from compatible devices
6 Assignable audio outputs allow audio to be independently de-embedded from sources or outputs via Toslink optical
A/V Mute mode allows the routing of a signal to an output to be deactivated
API controlled standby mode allows the matrix to enter a low power state when not in use, cutting power consumption by up to 34%
SmartEDID TM feature also dynamically detects display/source capabilities and automatically outputs the highest possible resolution
Embedded WyreStorm WebUI enables simple source switching and installer set-up & configuration
WebUI includes full EDID management to read, copy, store or import EDID from connected devices
IR learning function allows source switching in a zone to be triggered by an IR command other than the default
Simple switching matrix remote control included, which can be learned into a universal remote handset to allow the control of multiple devices from one handset
Compact 1U chassis with adjustable depth rack mounting brackets included
Input supports DVI/D and DisplayPort Dual-Mode (DP++) v1.3 with adapter (not included)
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

The MXV-0808-H2A-KIT delivers the same powerful performance as the standalone MXV-0808-H2A matrix switcher, now bundled with 6 standard HDBaseT receivers and 2 scaling receivers—making it an ideal solution for installations with a mix of 4K and 1080p displays. Capable of transmitting full 18Gbps HDMI content up to 35m/115ft using WyreStorm’s advanced lossless compression (VLC), this kit maintains perfect signal integrity without compromising color fidelity—unlike other methods such as CSC that permanently discard color data. With 8 HDBaseT zone outputs and 4 mirrored HDMI outputs, plus CEC triggering across all 12 display connections, the MXV-0808-H2A-KIT ensures seamless video distribution in residential or commercial environments where display compatibility and reliability are key.

In addition to the audio breakout ports, the MXV 8×8 also features four HDMI mirrored output ports which can be paired with any of WyreStorm’s HAOC hybrid optical HDMI cables for transmission up to 50m/164ft or any extender for transmission of HDBaseT or OM3 fiber.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Working automatically on signal presence or triggered via the API, the MXV 8x8 can send power trigger commands to all compatible connected screens or projectors meaning an integrated autonomous control solution

In addition to the audio breakout ports, the MXV 8x8 also features four HDMI mirrored output ports which can be paired with any of WyreStorm's HAOC hybrid optical HDMI cables for transmission up to 50m/164ft or any extender for transmission of HDBaseT or OM3 fiber.
4K HDR HDBaseT 8x8 Matrix Switch, supporting:
Proprietary compression algorithm enables 60Hz 4K UHD content (4:4:4 or HDR) to be sent over HDBaseT to 35m/115ft
Compatible with DVI-I and DP++ v1.3 signals from compatible devices
8 Assignable audio outputs allow audio to be independently de-embedded from sources or outputs via Toslink optical
A/V Mute mode allows the routing of a signal to an output to be deactivated
API controlled standby mode allows the matrix to enter a low power state when not in use, cutting power consumption by up to 34%
SmartEDID TM feature also dynamically detects display/source capabilities and automatically outputs the highest possible resolution
Embedded WyreStorm WebUI enables simple source switching and installer set-up & configuration
WebUI includes full EDID management to read, copy, store or import EDID from connected devices
IR learning function allows source switching in a zone to be triggered by an IR command other than the default
Simple switching matrix remote control included, which can be learned into a universal remote handset to allow the control of multiple devices from one handset
Compact 1U chassis with adjustable depth rack mounting brackets included
Input supports DVI/D and DisplayPort Dual-Mode (DP++) v1.3 with adapter (not included)
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-000-CTL IP controller is designed to be used with NetworkHD 100, 200, 400 & 600 Series systems to bridge the various encoders and decoders to a single, API-based connection point for use by a control processor or the NetworkHD Touch TM App. The NHD-000-CTL also provides monitoring and remote access for Integrators via its on-board Web UI.
Two isolated NICs provide the option to interface with two separate Networks or VLANs offering a secure and hassle-free option for simple switch setups.

Dual Ethernet ports for complete isolation of control and AV network traffic, enables the use of multiple LANs, VLANs or unified network topologies depending on the requirements of the project. The NHD-000-CTL supports PoE, simplifying cabling and equipment considerations.

Removing the complexity of requiring a control system to talk to every NetworkHD component, the NHD-000-CTL provides a unified control and monitoring interface point. Multiple NHD-000-CTLs can co-exist on a network, offering Hot or Cold backup options for mission critical deployments.

The NHD-0401-MV is a powerful multiview switcher that can be used as a standalone solution or with a NetworkHD 400 or 500 series system. The switcher comes pre-loaded with six different multiview layouts offering unique viewing experiences. 4K60 HDMI 2.0 inputs allow the switcher to support all the latest 4K HDR content with zero compression. Direct integration with the NHD-CTL-PRO provides a seamless solution for pairing this switcher with NetworkHD encoders & decoders to add multiview capability to an AV over IP project.

Each input supports the latest HDMI 2.0 content, including 4K60 4:4:4 and high dynamic range such as HDR10, HLG and Dolby Vision. A built-in HDMI downscaler will automatically adjust the resolution to match the maximum capability of the connected display.

The NHD-110-RX is the AV decoder to the powerful 110 series of NetworkHD AV over IP components. The 110 series components provides video encoding/decoding of up to 1080p60Hz content over a network. The NHD-110-RX can natively process up to a 16×16 video wall to create captivating digital landscapes and also includes a powerful video scaler to provide instant matrix switching. The 110 series components are also compatible with the NHD-150-RX multiview receiver allowing up to 9 unique streams to be sent to a single display.

The NetworkHD TM 100 Series utilizes low bandwidth, infinitely scalable technology with the addition of powerful video wall support up to 16×16 for the best all-round solution for commercial AV installations. A 100 Series encoder can either be paired with a 100 Series decoder for matrix switching to individual screens or for video wall decoding, with both decoders including HDMI and analog audio breakout outputs, or an NHD-150-RX decoder for multiview monitoring.

Each NHD-110-RX features a powerful video scaler. These scalers can operate automatically or be forced to transmit a specific video timing and format. Having scalers ensure you will always have a video signal no matter the display you connect to. Not to mention, the amazing seamless video switching capability.

Every signal that passes through a NetworkHD 110 system can be discretely routed. This includes video, audio, IR, RS-232, USB, and CEC. NetworkHD provides the most flexibility possible and can be perfectly tailored to your application requirements.

The NHD-110-RX-S is an AV decoder to the powerful 110 series of NetworkHD components. This “S” model has been treated with Sealoc’s Weatherloc technology to resist the elements such as water, moisture, humidity, dust, salt-fog, salt-air, acidic products and more. The 110 series components supports video encoding/decoding of up to 1080p60Hz content. The NHD-110-RX can natively process up to a 16x16 video wall to create captivating digital landscapes. The 110 series components are also compatible with the NHD-150-RX multiview receiver allowing up to 9 unique streams to be sent to a single display.

A pioneering collaboration with Sealoc and their proprietary Weatherloc technology, WyreStorm weatherproofed AV over IP receivers protect the endpoints of your AV solutions from the demanding outdoor environments. From coastal climates to dust particles and everything in between, the NetworkHD Sealoc receiver provides the perfect AV solution for customer engaging patio displays, video walls for live events, or even outdoor digital signage without any need for bulky weather proof boxes that prevent ventilation.

Each NHD-110-RX-S features a powerful video scaler. These scalers can operate automatically or be forced to transmit a specific video timing and format. Having scalers ensure you will always have a video signal no matter the display you connect to. Not to mention, the amazing seamless video switching capability.

Experience unmatched versatility with the NHD-120-IW-TX, your ultimate AV over IP solution. This 2-gang in-wall encoder, part of our 100 series, boasts an HDMI input and a dedicated Ethernet port, designed to seamlessly integrate with today's modern laptops and tablets. Whether you're enhancing your educational setup or optimizing your corporate environment, this encoder is your key to success.

The NetworkHD™ 100 Series utilizes low bandwidth, infinitely scalable technology with the addition of powerful video wall support up to 16×16 for the best all-round solution for commercial AV installations. A 100 Series encoder can either be paired with a 100 Series decoder for matrix switching to individual screens or for video wall decoding, with both decoders including HDMI and analog audio breakout outputs, or an NHD-150-RX decoder for multiview monitoring.

Choose your flavor, the NHD-120-IW-TX can encode AV signal using either H.264 or H.265. Using H.265 provides incredibly efficient video streams. For comparison, an H.265 5Mbps stream is equal to a 30Mbps H.264 stream.
The NHD-120-TX can encode AV signal using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.

The NHD-120-TX is now supporting 4K content that ensures compatibility with the HDMI v1.4 HDCP 2.2 video source, while a built-in scaler ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.

The NetworkHD 120 series takes the award-winning 100 series and elevates to a new level. The 120 series components support both video encoding/decoding. With 4K resolution, video transmissions look better than ever and use up to 6x less bandwidth. AV stream are fully secure over the network using AES 128-bit encryption methods, ensuring any sensitive data cannot be maliciously accessed. Of course, the series would not be complete without retaining the powerful video wall and Multiview processing. The 120 series does one better by adding screen rotation and mosaic video wall ability.

The NetworkHD TM 100 Series utilizes low bandwidth, infinitely scalable technology with the addition of powerful video wall support up to 16×16 for the best all-round solution for commercial AV installations. A 100 Series encoder can either be paired with a 100 Series decoder for matrix switching to individual screens or for video wall decoding, with both decoders including HDMI and analog audio breakout outputs, or an NHD-150-RX decoder for multiview monitoring.
The NHD-120-RX can decode AV signals from the transmitter using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.

The NHD-120-RX is now supporting 4K content that ensures compatibility with the HDMI v1.4 HDCP 2.2 video source, while a built-in scaler ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.

The NHD-120-TX is now supporting 4K content that ensures compatibility with the HDMI v1.4 HDCP 2.2 video source, while a built-in scaler ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.
The NHD-120-RX also allows you to create mosaic video walls with image rotation.

Boasting the ultimate in signal flexibility, the 120 Series can discretely deliver audio, infrared, and RS-232 streams separate to the video via a modular IP network. True signal breakaway can create custom assignments.
Compatible with the NetworkHD Touch and Companion Control apps. Control source, matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

From coastal climates to dust particles and everything in between, the NetworkHD Sealoc receiver provides the perfect AV solution for customer engaging patio displays, video walls for live events, or even outdoor digital signage without any need for bulky weather proof boxes that prevent ventilation.
The NHD-120-RX-S can decode AV signal using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.
The NHD-120-TX can encode AV signal using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.

Security is key in today’s world. The NetworkHD 120 series support AES 128-bit AV encryption over the network. Data sent from an NHD-120-TX is encapsulated using advanced methods to ensure that sensitive or private data cannot be accessed by 3rd-parties.

Security is key in today’s world. The NetworkHD 110 series support AES 128-bit AV encryption over the network. Data sent from an NHD-110-TX is encapsulated using advanced methods to ensure that sensitive or private data cannot be accessed by 3rd-parties.
The 120 series also allows you to create mosaic video walls with image rotation.

Boasting the ultimate in signal flexibility, the 120 Series can discretely deliver audio, infrared, and RS-232 streams separate to the video via a modular IP network. True signal breakaway can create custom assignments.
Compatible with the NetworkHD Touch and Companion Control apps. Control source, matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

empowers users to effortlessly monitor their devices from anywhere in the world. With a comprehensive suite of features, it enables seamless device control, firmware updates, and access to online support, all in one centralized location.
Both HDMI and Analog outputs allow discrete audio routing from any available NHD-120-TX on the same network.

The NetworkHD 120 series takes the award-winning 100 series and elevates to a new level. The 120 series components support both video encoding/decoding. With 4K resolution, video transmissions look better than ever and use up to 6x less bandwidth. AV stream are fully secure over the network using AES 128-bit encryption methods, ensuring any sensitive data cannot be maliciously accessed. Of course, the series would not be complete without retaining the powerful video wall and Multiview processing. The 120 series does one better by adding screen rotation and mosaic video wall ability.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NetworkHD 120 series takes the award-winning 100 series and elevates to a new level. The 120 series components support both video encoding/decoding. With 4K resolution, video transmissions look better than ever and use up to 6x less bandwidth. AV stream are fully secure over the network using AES 128-bit encryption methods, ensuring any sensitive data cannot be maliciously accessed. Of course, the series would not be complete without retaining the powerful video wall and Multiview processing. The 120 series does one better by adding screen rotation and mosaic video wall ability.

The NetworkHD TM 100 Series utilizes low bandwidth, infinitely scalable technology with the addition of powerful video wall support up to 16×16 for the best all-round solution for commercial AV installations. A 100 Series encoder can either be paired with a 100 Series decoder for matrix switching to individual screens or for video wall decoding, with both decoders including HDMI and analog audio breakout outputs, or an NHD-150-RX decoder for multiview monitoring.
The NHD-120-TX can encode AV signal using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.

The NHD-120-TX is now supporting 4K content that ensures compatibility with the HDMI v1.4 HDCP 2.2 video source, while a built-in scaler ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.

Security is key in today’s world. The NetworkHD 120 series support AES 128-bit AV encryption over the network. Data sent from an NHD-120-TX is encapsulated using advanced methods to ensure that sensitive or private data cannot be accessed by 3rd-parties.

The 120 series also allows you to create mosaic video walls with image rotation.

Boasting the ultimate in signal flexibility, the 120 Series can discretely deliver audio, infrared, and RS-232 streams separate to the video via a modular IP network. True signal breakaway can create custom assignments.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-124-TX is a 4 input to 4 network stream device encoder compatible with the NetworkHD 100 an ultra low bandwidth AV over IP solution for distribution of point-to-point, one-to-many and many-to-many over a managed network. With its standards-based approach to video encoding, fast and simple system configuration and robust feature set, it provides the best value in networked video distribution.

The NHD-124-TX encoder is intended for use with 120 series decoders (sold separately) to provide a complete end-to-end video distribution system. When used in conjunction with the NHD-CTL-PRO system controller complete control integration is simple.

The NetworkHD TM 100 Series utilizes low bandwidth, infinitely scalable technology with the addition of powerful video wall support up to 16×16 for the best all-round solution for commercial AV installations. A 100 Series encoder can either be paired with a 100 Series decoder for matrix switching to individual screens or for video wall decoding, with both decoders including HDMI and analog audio breakout outputs, or an NHD-150-RX decoder for multiview monitoring.
The NHD-124-TX can encode AV signal using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.

Space is always a factor when building an AV over IP system, and lack of it can cause headaches for any installer. Our NHD-124-TX solves this by combining four transmitters into one solution, allowing you to have the same functionality on a 1U footprint.
The NHD-124-TX is now supporting 4K content that ensures compatibility with the HDMI v1.4 HDCP 2.2 video source.

Security is key in today’s world. The NHD-124-TX support AES 128-bit AV encryption over the network. Data sent from an NHD-124-TX is encapsulated using advanced methods to ensure that sensitive or private data cannot be accessed by 3rd-parties.

Designed for flexibility, it allows up to 8 NDI streams to be converted into NetworkHD transmitters, while simultaneously outputting one NHD channel to NDI for integration with platforms such as Microsoft Teams, OBS, or vMix.

Compact and PoE-powered, the NHD-128-NDI-TRX simplifies deployment and reduces system complexity by replacing multiple converters with a single, all-in-one device. The device is fully compatible with WyreStorm Sygma Cloud, enabling remote monitoring, firmware updates, and proactive management from anywhere.
Perfect for digital courtrooms, lecture halls, and corporate AV environments, this gateway enables unified workflows where NDI and NHD coexist effortlessly.

The NetworkHD™ 100 Series utilizes low bandwidth, infinitely scalable technology with the addition of powerful video wall support up to 16×16 for the best all-round solution for commercial AV installations. A 100 Series encoder can either be paired with a 100 Series decoder for matrix switching to individual screens or for video wall decoding, with both decoders including HDMI and analog audio breakout outputs, or an NHD-150-RX decoder for multiview monitoring.
The NHD-150-RX can decode AV signal using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.

The NHD-150-RX multi-view processor is capable of displaying up to eight videos for 4K@30 or up to nine videos for 1080p@60 simultaneously on a single 4K display, allowing users to choose between many different layouts.
Compatible with the NetworkHD Touch Control app. Control source, matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each Encoder.

The NHD-400-DNT-TX encoder offers stunning 4K HDR video, multichannel audio support and video resolution scaling to seamlessly handle mixed resolution HDMI sources for matrix and video wall functionality. Equipped with a Dante audio encoder the 400 Series embraces the flexibility of standardized audio distribution. Featuring incredible low latency the 400 Series is the ideal AV over IP solution for systems where high quality and low delay are key requirements, making it perfect for demanding commercial applications.

The NHD-400-DNT-TX JPEG 2000 encoder is intended for use with any 400 Series JPEG 2000 decoder (sold separately) to provide a complete end-to-end video distribution system. When used in conjunction with Dante compatible audio equipment the 400 Series can distribute source HDMI or analog audio throughout an installation.

Delivering visually lossless 4K UHD content with HDR and HDCP 2.2 support the 400 Series ensures compatibility with the latest UHD video sources, while a built-in scaler at the decoder ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.

Empowered with a Dante audio encoder, Dante networks can benefit from the streaming of source audio from an encoder HDMI or analog port direct to Dante compatible audio amplifiers, DSPs or mixing consoles.

Supporting traditional video walls, as well as customizable mosaic styles, perfect for building captivating & creative digital signage. JPEG2000 encoding ensuring distribution integrity and video latency of less than a single frame makes the 400 Series ideal for live environments.

As part of the WyreStorm NetworkHD 400 Series, the NHD-400-TX streaming encoder offers stunning 4K HDR video, multi-channel audio support and 4K/2K auto-scaling to seamlessly handle mixed resolution sources, content and display devices for matrix and video wall functionality when used in conjunction with a 400 Series decoder.

Delivering visually lossless 4K UHD content with HDR and HDCP 2.2 support ensures compatibility with the latest UHD video sources, while a built-in scaler ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.

Supporting traditional video walls, as well as customizable mosaic styles, perfect for building captivating & creative digital signage. JPEG2000 encoding ensuring distribution integrity and video latency of less than a single frame makes the 400 Series ideal for live environments.

Boasting the ultimate in signal flexibility, the 400 Series can discretely deliver audio, infrared and USB streams separate to the video via a modular IP network. True signal breakaway can create custom assignments, desirable in both commercial and residential applications.

The NetworkHD 500s series is an HDMI 2.0 AV over IP solution. Capable of encoding up to 4K60 including Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG content. The 500 series comes loaded with a number of advanced features such as the flexibility of Ethernet or Fiber as a transport method. Ultra-low latency encoding and incredibly fast matrix switching speeds enhance the experience. A powerful routing engine allows audio, video, USB and control signals to be discretely sent to any endpoint. Create captivating video walls up to 16x16 in size and control them with the tap of a button in the amazing NetworkHD Touch control app.
Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network.

Audio Return Channel (ARC) via HDMI allows audio from a display to transmit over the network to a 500 series encoder for connection to a compatible AVR. ARC supports up to Dolby Digital Plus and DTS 5.1 formats. Have an older display? Take advantage of the Toslink passthrough to transmit audio in the same way.

Create captivating large format video walls with the ability to process up to 256 screens (16x16). Easily adjust for screen bezels to ensure the video is picture-perfect. The 500 series also allow you to create mosaic style walls with rotated screens!
The 500s are fully compatible with the NetworkHD Touch control app. Effortlessly control matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

The NetworkHD 500s series is an HDMI 2.0 AV over IP solution. Capable of encoding up to 4K60 including Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG content. The 500 series comes loaded with a number of advanced features such as the flexibility of Ethernet or Fiber as a transport method. Ultra-low latency encoding and incredibly fast matrix switching speeds enhance the experience. A powerful routing engine allows audio, video, USB and control signals to be discretely sent to any endpoint. Create captivating video walls up to 16x16 in size and control them with the tap of a button in the amazing NetworkHD Touch control app.
Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network.

Equipped with both Ethernet and Fiber outputs, the 500 series offers flexibility for any installation. Ethernet can support transmissions up to 100m (328ft) and fiber is capable of a stunning 10KM using SMF.

Audio Return Channel (ARC) via HDMI allows audio from a display to transmit over the network to a 500 series encoder for connection to a compatible AVR. ARC supports up to Dolby Digital Plus and DTS 5.1 formats. Have an older display? Take advantage of the Toslink passthrough to transmit audio in the same way.

Create captivating large format video walls with the ability to process up to 256 screens (16x16). Easily adjust for screen bezels to ensure the video is picture-perfect. The 500 series also allow you to create mosaic style walls with rotated screens!
4ms when in passthrough mode allows content to be distributed without any perceivable delay.
The 500s are fully compatible with the NetworkHD Touch control app. Effortlessly control matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-500-DNT-TX is part of the powerful NetworkHD 500 series family of products. Capable of encoding up to 4K60 including Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG content. The 500 series comes loaded with a number of advanced features such as the flexibility of Ethernet or Fiber as a transport method. Ultra-low latency encoding and incredibly fast matrix switching speeds enhance the experience. Unique to this encoder is an integrated 2 channel Dante & AES67 audio output.

The integrated 2 channel Dante & AES67 output allows audio to be sent over the network to compatible Dante & AES67 enabled DSPs, amplifiers, mixers and more. Audio can be transmitted via Dante from either the encoder’s HDMI input or a separate analog input.

Dante audio and NetworkHD A/V can be integrated into the same network or separated via a dedicated Dante-only port. If 3rd-party Dante equipment exists on a dedicated network, simply connect the Dante-only port to keep things separate and avoid complicated network configurations.
Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network.

Equipped with both Ethernet and Fiber outputs, the 500 series offers flexibility for any installation. Ethernet can support transmissions up to 100m (328ft) and fiber is capable of a stunning 10KM using SMF.
Less than a single frame a latency (16ms) when in passthrough mode allows content to be distributed without any perceivable delay.
The 500s are fully compatible with the NetworkHD Touch control app. Effortlessly control matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

The TAA compliant NetworkHD 500s series is an HDMI 2.0 AV over IP solution. Capable of encoding up to 4K60 including Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG content. The 500 series comes loaded with a number of advanced features such as the flexibility of Ethernet or Fiber as a transport method. Ultra-low latency encoding and incredibly fast matrix switching speeds enhance the experience. A powerful routing engine allows audio, video, USB and control signals to be discretely sent to any endpoint. Create captivating video walls up to 16x16 in size and control them with the tap of a button in the amazing NetworkHD Touch control app.
Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network.

Audio Return Channel (ARC) via HDMI allows audio from a display to transmit over the network to a 500 series encoder for connection to a compatible AVR. ARC supports up to Dolby Digital Plus and DTS 5.1 formats. Have an older display? Take advantage of the Toslink passthrough to transmit audio in the same way.

Create captivating large format video walls with the ability to process up to 256 screens (16x16). Easily adjust for screen bezels to ensure the video is picture-perfect. The 500 series also allow you to create mosaic style walls with rotated screens!
The 500s are fully compatible with the NetworkHD Touch control app. Effortlessly control matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The TAA compliant NetworkHD 500s series is an HDMI 2.0 AV over IP solution. Capable of encoding up to 4K60 including Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG content. The 500 series comes loaded with a number of advanced features such as the flexibility of Ethernet or Fiber as a transport method. Ultra-low latency encoding and incredibly fast matrix switching speeds enhance the experience. A powerful routing engine allows audio, video, USB and control signals to be discretely sent to any endpoint. Create captivating video walls up to 16x16 in size and control them with the tap of a button in the amazing NetworkHD Touch control app.
Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network.

Equipped with both Ethernet and Fiber outputs, the 500 series offers flexibility for any installation. Ethernet can support transmissions up to 100m (328ft) and fiber is capable of a stunning 550m (1800ft) using OM3 MMF.

Audio Return Channel (ARC) via HDMI allows audio from a display to transmit over the network to a 500 series encoder for connection to a compatible AVR. ARC supports up to Dolby Digital Plus and DTS 5.1 formats. Have an older display? Take advantage of the Toslink passthrough to transmit audio in the same way.

Create captivating large format video walls with the ability to process up to 256 screens (16x16). Easily adjust for screen bezels to ensure the video is picture-perfect. The 500 series also allow you to create mosaic style walls with rotated screens!
Less than a single frame a latency (16ms) when in passthrough mode allows content to be distributed without any perceivable delay.
The 500s are fully compatible with the NetworkHD Touch control app. Effortlessly control matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

Ultra-low latency encoding and incredibly fast matrix switching speeds enhance the experience. Create captivating video walls up to 16x16 in size and control them with the tap of a button in the amazing NetworkHD Touch control app.

Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network. NHD-500-TX v2 comes with HDMI loop out for local monitor.
Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network.

Equipped with both Ethernet and Fiber outputs, the 500 series offers flexibility for any installation. Ethernet can support transmissions up to 100m (328ft) and fiber is capable of a stunning 550m (1800ft) using OM3 MMF.

Audio Return Channel (ARC) via HDMI allows audio from a display to transmit over the network to a 500 series encoder for connection to a compatible AVR. Create captivating large format video walls with the ability to process up to 256 screens (16x16). Easily adjust for screen bezels to ensure the video is picture-perfect. The 500 series also allow you to create mosaic style walls with rotated screens!
4ms when in passthrough mode allows content to be distributed without any perceivable delay.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NetworkHD 500s series is an HDMI 2.0 AV over IP solution. Capable of encoding up to 4K60 including Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG content. The 500 series comes loaded with a number of advanced features such as the flexibility of Ethernet or Fiber as a transport method. Ultra-low latency encoding and incredibly fast matrix switching speeds enhance the experience. A powerful routing engine allows audio, video, USB and control signals to be discretely sent to any endpoint. Create captivating video walls up to 16x16 in size and control them with the tap of a button in the amazing NetworkHD Touch control app.

Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network. NHD-500-TX v2 comes with HDMI loop out for local monitor.
Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network.

Equipped with both Ethernet and Fiber outputs, the 500 series offers flexibility for any installation. Ethernet can support transmissions up to 100m (328ft) and fiber is capable of a stunning 550m (1800ft) using OM3 MMF.

Audio Return Channel (ARC) via HDMI allows audio from a display to transmit over the network to a 500 series encoder for connection to a compatible AVR. ARC supports up to Dolby Digital Plus and DTS 5.1 formats. Have an older display? Take advantage of the Toslink passthrough to transmit audio in the same way.

Create captivating large format video walls with the ability to process up to 256 screens (16x16). Easily adjust for screen bezels to ensure the video is picture-perfect. The 500 series also allow you to create mosaic style walls with rotated screens!
4ms when in passthrough mode allows content to be distributed without any perceivable delay.
The 500s are fully compatible with the NetworkHD Touch control app. Effortlessly control matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-510-TX is a powerhouse in AV over IP technology, integrating HDMI and USB-C inputs for unparalleled connectivity with both traditional and modern digital devices. Enhanced with Dante AV-A support for superior audio over IP, HDMI loop-out for local display connectivity, and advanced audio switching capabilities, it stands as an essential component for any high-definition setup. As a 1 Gigabit solution, it confidently supports 4K60 4:4:4 video resolution, ensuring crystal-clear image quality across all applications. Whether upgrading commercial spaces, educational institutions, or secure government facilities, the NHD-510-TX delivers an immersive audiovisual experience with HDR10 and Dolby Vision support, minimal latency, and the ability to connect up to 7 USB devices simultaneously. This device is designed to meet the rigorous demands of any complex installation, offering a versatile, high-performance solution for contemporary AV challenges.

The NHD-510-TX revolutionizes input management with intelligent HDMI and USB-C ports that automatically switch between sources, ensuring seamless transitions during presentations or collaborative sessions. This auto-switch feature simplifies the user experience by automatically selecting the active input, making it effortless to manage multiple devices in dynamic AV environments.
Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz

The 500s series in fully compatible with the intuitive NetworkHD Touch control app for iPad and Android tablets. Effortlessly control matrix and video wall switching with high-definition preview streams of each encoder’s source. Control couldn’t be easier with a drag-and-drop intuitive interface all for free!

Immediate Content Switching in Less Than 1 Second. Experience the pinnacle of efficiency with the NHD-510-TX's ultra-fast switching capability, enabling transitions between sources in less than 1 second. This feature is crucial for environments that require quick changes without interruption, offering a virtually seamless experience for users and viewers alike, ensuring that presentations, broadcasts, and collaborative efforts proceed smoothly and without delay.
Elevate your audio distribution with the NHD-510-TX's support for Dante AV-A, featuring 2x2 channels of high-quality audio over IP on dedicated Dante ethernet port.(license required)
4ms when in passthrough mode allows content to be distributed without any perceivable delay.

empowers users to effortlessly monitor their devices from anywhere in the world. With a comprehensive suite of features, it enables seamless device control, firmware updates, and access to online support, all in one centralized location.

The NHD-600-E encoder and decoder delivers cost-optimized, high-performance SDVoE AV over IP transmission and reception. The “E” variations remove some of the I/O found on the standard encoder and decoder and retain only the core functionalities that suite most applications. Engineered for installations requiring pixel-perfect 4K60 4:4:4 video with zero-frame latency, this series supports robust 10GbE network operation with PoE+ power and a flexible AV control suite.

Deliver pixel-perfect, lossless video with support for up to 4K60 4:4:4 over HDMI 2.0, including HDR formats such as HDR10, HLG, and Dolby Vision (low latency). The SDVoE architecture ensures uncompromised image quality and zero-frame latency, while analog audio support enables flexible audio routing or de-embedding alongside HDMI audio.

Designed for streamlined installation, the NHD-600-E supports PoE+ (802.3at) power to reduce cabling complexity. HDMI 2.0 connectivity is provided on both encoder and decoder models, alongside analog audio connections and bidirectional IR and RS-232 passthrough for seamless integration with external devices.

Built on a 10GbE SDVoE network backbone, the 600-E enables reliable AV distribution across point-to-point and matrix-based systems. Integrated support for network-based control allows IR and RS-232 signals to be transmitted alongside video and audio, ensuring compatibility with third-party control platforms and automation systems.

Powered by SDVoE technology, the NHD-600-E delivers true zero-frame latency for real-time video transmission. This ensures perfectly synchronized audio and video, making it ideal for live presentation environments, control rooms, and interactive AV systems where timing accuracy is critical.

The NetworkHD 610 TX and RX expand the functionality of the powerful SDVoE 600 series product line. The 610s retain many of the capabilities found on the other models, such as full HDMI 2.0 encoding, zero latency transmissions, video wall and multiview processing. However, the 610s pack an extra punch by incorporating a Dante/AES67 output on the NHD-610-TX, allowing audio from the HDMI or analog audio input to transmit to Dante/AES67 enabled amplifiers, DSP or mixers. Both the TX and RX are also equipped with a full speed USB 2.0 chipset maximizing compatibility with thousands of USB peripherals for extension over the network, such as a keyboard/mouse, webcams, touchscreens, or just simple data transfers.

The NHD-610-TX is equipped with a 2CH Dante audio transmitter. Audio from either the HDMI or analog audio input can be sent over the network using Dante protocols for a latency free and lossless delivery to compatible audio equipment. We’ve also made sure AES67 is supported to expand compatibility with even more audio receivers.

All 600 series components support encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG. Most HDMI content is transmitted completely uncompressed and delivered over the network latency free using genlock synchronization.

The NHD-610-RX integrates powerful video wall and multiview processing via one device. Create captivating videos up to 8x8 in size with the ability to adjust for bezels. Or create compelling picture in picture layouts that support up to 16 windows with full control over window placement and size.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NetworkHD 610 TX and RX expand the functionality of the powerful SDVoE 600 series product line. The 610s retain many of the capabilities found on the other models, such as full HDMI 2.0 encoding, zero latency transmissions, video wall and multiview processing. However, the 610s pack an extra punch by incorporating a Dante/AES67 output on the NHD-610-TX, allowing audio from the HDMI or analog audio input to transmit to Dante/AES67 enabled amplifiers, DSP or mixers. Both the TX and RX are also equipped with a full speed USB 2.0 chipset maximizing compatibility with thousands of USB peripherals for extension over the network, such as a keyboard/mouse, webcams, touchscreens, or just simple data transfers.

With all the bells & whistles of a flagship AV over IP solution, the NetworkHD 610 Series provides clarity and performance for those environments requiring detail and responsiveness. Whether monitoring mission critical AV feeds from a control room, immersed in the competitive E-Sports environment, or requiring crystal clear visuals in the medical field, this AV over IP distribution solution exceeds with no limitations.

The NHD-610-TX is equipped with a 2CH Dante audio transmitter. Audio from either the HDMI or analog audio input can be sent over the network using Dante protocols for a latency free and lossless delivery to compatible audio equipment. We’ve also made sure AES67 is supported to expand compatibility with even more audio receivers.

Both the TX and RX are equipped with USB host and devices ports. The highspeed chipset allows full USB 2.0 480Mbps data rates ensuring compatibility with practically any peripheral you plug in. The USB data flow can be customized allowing either the 610-TX or RX to act as a USB host depending on application requirements.

All 600 series components support encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG. Most HDMI content is transmitted completely uncompressed and delivered over the network latency free using genlock synchronization.

The NHD-610-RX integrates powerful video wall and multiview processing via one device. Create captivating videos up to 8x8 in size with the ability to adjust for bezels. Or create compelling picture in picture layouts that support up to 16 windows with full control over window placement and size.
Compatible with the 802.3at PoE+ protocol, the 610s can power from a compatible network switch removing the need to use cumbersome DC power supplies.
An auxiliary 1GbE LAN port provides a bridged connection to the main 10G port for connecting peripherals. It can also be setup to isolate Dante audio to a separate network.
Supports seamless AV source switching via Fast Switch mode
Powerful matrix functionality includes routing control of all audio, video, RS-232 and IR signals
Compatible with NHD-000-RACK4 for easy rack mounting
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

The NetworkHD 610-TX expand the functionality of the powerful SDVoE 600 series product line. The 610-TX retain many of the capabilities found on the other models, such as full HDMI 2.0 encoding, zero latency transmissions, video wall and multiview processing. However, the 610 packs an extra punch by incorporating a Dante/AES67 output, allowing audio from the HDMI or analog audio input to transmit to Dante/AES67 enabled amplifiers, DSP or mixers. The TX is also equipped with a full speed USB 1.1 HID chipset, maximizing compatibility with thousands of USB peripherals for extension over the network, such as a keyboard/mouse & touchscreens, or just simple data transfers.

The NHD-610-TX is equipped with a 2CH Dante audio transmitter. Audio from either the HDMI or analog audio input can be sent over the network using Dante protocols for a latency free and lossless delivery to compatible audio equipment. We’ve also made sure AES67 is supported to expand compatibility with even more audio receivers.

All 600 series components support encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG. Most HDMI content is transmitted completely uncompressed and delivered over the network latency free using genlock synchronization.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NetworkHD 610-TX expand the functionality of the powerful SDVoE 600 series product line. The 610-TX retain many of the capabilities found on the other models, such as full HDMI 2.0 encoding, zero latency transmissions, video wall and multiview processing. However, the 610 packs an extra punch by incorporating a Dante/AES67 output, allowing audio from the HDMI or analog audio input to transmit to Dante/AES67 enabled amplifiers, DSP or mixers. The TX is also equipped with a full speed USB 1.1 HID chipset, maximizing compatibility with thousands of USB peripherals for extension over the network, such as a keyboard/mouse & touchscreens, or just simple data transfers.

With all the bells & whistles of a flagship AV over IP solution, the NetworkHD 610 Series provides clarity and performance for those environments requiring detail and responsiveness. Whether monitoring mission critical AV feeds from a control room, immersed in the competitive E-Sports environment, or requiring crystal clear visuals in the medical field, this AV over IP distribution solution exceeds with no limitations.

The NHD-610-TX is equipped with a 2CH Dante audio transmitter. Audio from either the HDMI or analog audio input can be sent over the network using Dante protocols for a latency free and lossless delivery to compatible audio equipment. We’ve also made sure AES67 is supported to expand compatibility with even more audio receivers.

The NHD-610-TX is equipped with 3x USB HID ports for extension and routing of a keyboard, mouse or game controllers . This makes it fully compatible with NHD-600-TRX. Using Genlock mode it will allow a lag-free experience.

All 600 series components support encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG. Most HDMI content is transmitted completely uncompressed and delivered over the network latency free using genlock synchronization.
Compatible with the 802.3at PoE+ protocol, the 610s can power from a compatible network switch removing the need to use cumbersome DC power supplies.
An auxiliary 1GbE LAN port provides a bridged connection to the main 10G port for connecting peripherals. It can also be setup to isolate Dante audio to a separate network.

Designed with precision, this rack mount ensures that your NetworkHD components are securely housed while maintaining optimal airflow and accessibility for maintenance. The 1U 2 Slot Rack offers exceptional flexibility, allowing scaling setup by selecting the exact number of racks needed based on the quantity of devices in the NetworkHD system—whether deploying a small-scale configuration or expanding to support a larger network infrastructure.

Horizontal slot installation supports combination of 2 NetworkHD Series 100/500/600 components or NHD-CTL-PRO v2 providing ideal component heat dissipation and airflow – a key factor in increasing reliability and product lifespan.

The NHD-USB-TRX is a powerful and flexible USB 2.0 over IP transceiver designed to work natively with the WyreStorm NetworkHD 500 series or in combination with other NetworkHD series. It allows the extension of USB devices like keyboards, mice, cameras, and other peripherals over an IP network, making it ideal for point-to-point or one-to-many applications. Equipped with PoE and SFP fiber connectivity, it provides installation flexibility and reliable performance even in large-scale deployments. The built-in two-level USB hub enables seamless integration of multiple USB devices, ensuring easy management across distances.

Easily configurable as either a transmitter or receiver using a simple DIP switch. This flexibility allows the device to be deployed in various roles within the same system, simplifying inventory and installation requirements.

Features built-in security protocols including HTTPS, SSH, and support for 802.1X authentication, ensuring secure data transmission and communication in sensitive environments like government or corporate networks.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-USB-TRX is a powerful and flexible USB 2.0 over IP transceiver designed to work natively with the WyreStorm NetworkHD 500 series or in combination with other NetworkHD series. It allows the extension of USB devices like keyboards, mice, cameras, and other peripherals over an IP network, making it ideal for point-to-point or one-to-many applications. Equipped with PoE and SFP fiber connectivity, it provides installation flexibility and reliable performance even in large-scale deployments. The built-in two-level USB hub enables seamless integration of multiple USB devices, ensuring easy management across distances.

With support for up to 7 USB devices and 21 endpoints, the NHD-USB-TRX is perfect for corporate, educational, healthcare, courtroom, and government applications. It also supports KM over IP for fast, low-latency switching between multiple devices or screens, delivering a highly efficient and seamless experience for users in control rooms and collaborative environments.

Seamlessly extend USB 2.0 devices over an IP network with support for point-to-point or one-to-many setups. Perfect for connecting USB peripherals like cameras, keyboards, and storage devices across multiple rooms or locations.
The NHD-120-TX can encode AV signal using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.
Supports up to 7 USB devices and 21 endpoints, providing local and remote USB integration for flexible device management.

Supports both direct point-to-point connections and one-to-many configurations via a network switch, providing up to 21 endpoints for large-scale or complex installations. This allows for efficient USB routing between multiple devices and locations.

Security is key in today’s world. The NetworkHD 110 series support AES 128-bit AV encryption over the network. Data sent from an NHD-110-TX is encapsulated using advanced methods to ensure that sensitive or private data cannot be accessed by 3rd-parties.

Easily configurable as either a transmitter or receiver using a simple DIP switch. This flexibility allows the device to be deployed in various roles within the same system, simplifying inventory and installation requirements.
The 120 series also allows you to create mosaic video walls with image rotation.
Enables seamless Keyboard and Mouse (KM) over IP control with low-latency switching and roaming, ideal for control rooms and collaborative workspaces.

Features built-in security protocols including HTTPS, SSH, and support for 802.1X authentication, ensuring secure data transmission and communication in sensitive environments like government or corporate networks.

Boasting the ultimate in signal flexibility, the 120 Series can discretely deliver audio, infrared, and RS-232 streams separate to the video via a modular IP network. True signal breakaway can create custom assignments.
Compatible with the NetworkHD Touch and Companion Control apps. Control source, matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

Compact Class B HDBaseT receiver supporting 4K HDR transmissions up to 35 meters from a compatible HDBaseT matrix or presentation switcher. 2-way PoH allows the RX-35-POH to power over category cable from a PoH matrix or switcher and also allows for the receiver to power in-wall HDBaseT transmitters.

The RX-500 still maintains the ability send HID’s and data back to the transmitter with USB 2.0 compatible devices such as HD webcams, smart white boards and data drives alike. Ideally suited for small meeting spaces and conference rooms, the RX-500 pairs perfectly with WyreStorm’s popular line of Presentation Solutions, such as the SW-130-TX or SW-510-TX to meet all of your presentation needs.

Utilizing the best in HDBaseT technology, the RX-700 extends 5-Play functionality to your display device over 100m/328ft of Cat6 cable. Using DSC (display stream compression) the RX-700 can support HDMI video up to 2160p 4:4:4 at 60Hz without any visual loss in quality or latency. With HID’s and data transfer in mind, the RX-700 supports data transmission of USB 2.0 devices like HD webcams, smart whiteboards and flash drives alike.

Sporting an 18Gbps HDMI input, the RX-700 can support all UHD video signals up to and including 2160p 4:4:4/60, and high frame-rate HDR 12bit 4:2:2 up to 60Hz, along with multichannel audio up to DTS:X and Dolby Atmos.

Running in parallel to and completely separate to the HDMI signal within the HDBaseT link, the RX-700 can also support the bi-directional transmission of 2 separate stereo audio feeds, to and from the RX-700.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

As space between displays and the wall they’re mounted to reduces, finding a receiver to fit in this gap can be hard to find. But just because this receiver packs a punch doesn’t mean it can’t deliver the small footprint that you’ve come to expect. It also ships complete with all the accessories needed to help the integrator complete the install discreetly and efficiently.

The very core of WyreStorm transmission, we’ve embraced HDBaseT technology since 2010. featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The very core of WyreStorm transmission, we've embraced HDBaseT technology since 2010. We're now taking the capabilities of HDBaseT to the next level and supporting video bandwidths in excess of 10Gbps with our lossless compression technology built in to out H2X matrix platform. The RXV-70-4K will output HDMI content at up to 2160p 4:4:4/60.

As space between displays and the wall they're mounted to reduces, finding a receiver to fit in this gap can be hard to find. But just because this receiver packs a punch doesn't mean it can't deliver the small footprint that you've come to expect. It also ships complete with all the accessories needed to help the integrator complete the install discreetly and efficiently.
For use exclusively with H2XC matrix and TX-H2X-VLC modular card. Not compatible with MXV matrix range.
Compatible with HDR standards including HDR-10, HDR-10+, HLG and Dolby Vision (Dolby Vision supported up to 30Hz)
Class A HDBaseT supporting the transmission of video, multichannel audio, Ethernet, bidirectional control and PoH
Bidirectional IR supported with both IR TX & RX ports
Supports Ethernet pass-through from matrix (Class A HDBaseT transmission only)
Wall mounting brackets and IR accessories included
HDCP 2.2 | EDID | CEC | DVI-D supported with adapter (not included)
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

18Gbps HDBaseT receiver for the MXV-70 matrix switcher series. The RXV-70-G2-SCL features a powerful scaler that can convert 4K UHD and HDR content to a 1080p non-HDR display to maximize compatibility. The receiver also features stereo and digital S/PDIF audio breakout for easy external audio distribution.

The RXV-70-G2-SCL allows video output to be scaled to match the capabliity of the connected display. Transmit a 4K HDR source to a 4K HDR display and at the same time scale another zone to 1080p without effecting the quality of the source.

The very core of WyreStorm transmission, we’ve embraced HDBaseT technology since 2010. We’re now taking the capabilities of HDBaseT to the next level and supporting video bandwidths in excess of 10Gbps with our lossless compression technology built in to out H2X matrix platform. The RXV-70-G2-SCL will output HDMI content at up to 2160p 4:4:4/60.

Allows a transmission from a single HDMI audio/video device to be duplicated and simultaneously distributed to up to two HDMI display devices, such as TV, AVR, digital signage panel or digital projector

The SP-0108-SCL is a small and compact, yet powerful HDMI splitter that can be used in many applications, from digital signage, education, to retail or hospitality. Each HDMI output of the SP-0108-SCL features a 4K to 1080p down scaler, allowing for mixed resolution displays to be used simultaneously without suffering from compatibility limitations. An analog and digital S/PDIF audio de-embed allows easy connection for external amplifiers or DSPs.

Each of the 8 outputs on the SP-0108-SCL feature down scalers, which can be set via dipswitch or API, allowing support for mixed resolution distribution of HDMI content to 4K and 1080p display simultaneously.

Previous professional splitters offered basic EDID management with up to 8 different EDID settings, but the SP-0108-SCL provides more flexibility with its advance EDID management, boasting up to 16 pre-loaded EDIDs to choose from, ensuring reliable and consistent video distribution. We’ve further included a custom EDID setting, allowing you to upload your own unique EDID to use, making the SP-0108-SCL’s EDID library virtually unlimited. To make life even easier, manage EDID information through the API, dipswitches or copy and EDID from a display with the front panel buttons.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The SP-0108-SCL is a small and compact, yet powerful HDMI splitter that can be used in many applications, from digital signage, education, to retail or hospitality. Each HDMI output of the SP-0108-SCL features a 4K to 1080p down scaler, allowing for mixed resolution displays to be used simultaneously without suffering from compatibility limitations. An analog and digital S/PDIF audio de-embed allows easy connection for external amplifiers or DSPs.

Each of the 8 outputs on the SP-0108-SCL feature down scalers, which can be set via dipswitch or API, allowing support for mixed resolution distribution of HDMI content to 4K and 1080p display simultaneously.

Previous professional splitters offered basic EDID management with up to 8 different EDID settings, but the SP-0108-SCL provides more flexibility with its advance EDID management, boasting up to 16 pre-loaded EDIDs to choose from, ensuring reliable and consistent video distribution. We’ve further included a custom EDID setting, allowing you to upload your own unique EDID to use, making the SP-0108-SCL’s EDID library virtually unlimited. To make life even easier, manage EDID information through the API, dipswitches or copy and EDID from a display with the front panel buttons.

Working automatically on signal presence or triggered via the API, this 1x8 splitter can send power trigger commands to all compatible connected screens or projectors, meaning an integrated autonomous control solution.
Small compact design allows the splitter to be mounted locally and discreetly.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The SW-0204-VW 4x HDMI 2.0 Video Wall processor is an advanced 2x inputs (alternative) and 4x outputs video wall processor, providing video wall layout of 1x4 and 2x2 (rows x columns) with 4K and ultra-wide resolution support, independent analog audio output and image scaling. It also supports a user-friendly Web-UI, RS232 and Telnet for optimal flexibility control.

The SW-0204-VW supports 4-screen video walls with selectable modes, including 1x4 and 2x2 configurations. It extends the input video source across four displays, delivering stunning visual detail and an enhanced viewing experience. Advanced features, such as bezel correction, video wall flip, and flexible layout adjustments, allow precise customization for seamless multi-screen alignment.

Fully compatible with 4K@60Hz video content, the SW-0204-VW adheres to HDMI 2.0 and HDCP 2.3 standards. Its built-in scaling processor allows both upscaling and downscaling to resolutions up to 4K@60Hz 4:4:4, ensuring superior image quality and a fully immersive visual experience.

Supporting ultra-wide resolutions such as 3840x600, the SW-0204-VW is ideal for landscape-oriented video walls. This feature makes it a perfect choice for digital signage, conference rooms, and large-scale presentations.

The SW-0204-VW offers advanced audio functionality, including audio de-embedding from HDMI inputs and an audio mute option. These features provide clear, reliable audio output, complementing the visual performance of the video wall.

The SW-0206-VW is a 4K Video Wall Processor for multiple splicing layout, aiming to provide extreme viewing experience for customer. It offers 2 HDMI inputs (alternative) and 6 HDMI outputs to create a multiple splicing video wall, while it also provides 4K and ultra-wide resolution support, independent analog audio output and imaging scaling to establish a fully immersive experience. For flexible control, SW-0206-VW also supports various methods, such as a user-friendly Web-UI, front panel control button, RS232 and Telnet control options.
Supports a variety of video wall layouts to suit different needs:

These layouts enable seamless expansion of input video sources across multiple screens Additional features include bezel adjustment, rotation options (0°, 60°, 90°, 180°, 270°), and customizable layout adjustments for optimal flexibility.

Fully compliant with HDMI 2.0 and HDCP 2.3 standards, the SW-0206-VW supports 4K@60Hz content with rich color accuracy (4:4:4 chroma subsampling). Its built-in scaling processor ensures high-quality upscaling and downscaling for resolutions up to 4K@60Hz, delivering a truly immersive visual experience.

Designed for applications requiring expansive visuals, the SW-0206-VW supports ultra-wide resolutions, including 3840×600@60Hz and 5400×1920@30Hz. This makes it an excellent choice for digital signage, conference rooms, and large-scale presentations, where panoramic displays are essential.

The WyreStorm EXP-SW-0401-H2 is a powerful plug-and-play 4K switcher solution. With up to 18Gbps pure HDMI support, which allows up to four 4K HDR sources to be routed to a single display. The EXP-SW-0401-H2 is capable of auto switching, giving the user the convenience of simply turning on their favorite device without the requiring manual intervention. Furthermore, the EXP-SW-0401-H2 is equipped with signal compensation, allowing an extender or splitter to connect to its output without degrading or delaying the signal.

A trend you may notice is the plug-and-play features WyreStorm’s Essentials product line possesses and it doesn’t stop at our switchers. You can find the same auto EDID and HDCP negotiation found in other Essentials products, but specifically signal regeneration is what makes WyreStorm’s Essentials switchers the king of plug-and-play!

While the EXP-SW-0401-H2 is a stand-alone device, sometimes wiring to the display is too long for a standard HDMI cable, or maybe there are additional displays added. Because of its signal regeneration feature, additional devices can be connected to the output of the switch, like an extender set or splitter, all without signal delay or degradation.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm EXP-SW-0401-H2 is a powerful plug-and-play 4K switcher solution. With up to 18Gbps pure HDMI support, which allows up to four 4K HDR sources to be routed to a single display. The EXP-SW-0401-H2 is capable of auto switching, giving the user the convenience of simply turning on their favorite device without the requiring manual intervention. Furthermore, the EXP-SW-0401-H2 is equipped with signal compensation, allowing an extender or splitter to connect to its output without degrading or delaying the signal.
WyreStorm’s Essentials line of switchers follows the last in first out rule when it comes to auto-switching, making this a convenient feature when a new source is introduced.

A trend you may notice is the plug-and-play features WyreStorm’s Essentials product line possesses and it doesn’t stop at our switchers. You can find the same auto EDID and HDCP negotiation found in other Essentials products, but specifically signal regeneration is what makes WyreStorm’s Essentials switchers the king of plug-and-play!

While the EXP-SW-0401-H2 is a stand-alone device, sometimes wiring to the display is too long for a standard HDMI cable, or maybe there are additional displays added. Because of its signal regeneration feature, additional devices can be connected to the output of the switch, like an extender set or splitter, all without signal delay or degradation.
Slim design allows discrete placement, but sleek enough to show off in open space.

2 inputs and powerful HDBaseT 3.0 transmission result is this powerful switching transmitter, perfect for higher education classroom/lecture hall and corporate environments. Automatic or manual switching of HDMI or USB-C and CEC power triggering via HDBaseT means a simple user experience when it matters most. Further functionality allows USB devices to be routed back to the source via USB host (or natively via USB-C) alongside 3 additional USB device ports locally available for a total of 6 devices that can simultaneously used in conjunction with each input. Rounding out it’s long feature list, the SW-120-TX3 boasts 60 watts of charging over the connected USB-C device.

It's not just an HDBaseT switcher; it's a versatile powerhouse. Beyond seamless switching, it sends power trigger commands and delivers high-speed charging of up to 60 watts for devices like laptops and tablets. With remarkable flexibility, it can seamlessly power the receiver or draw power from it. It's truly the ultimate in-wall command center.

The little sibling to the RX-700, the RX-500 also utilizes HDBaseT 2.0 technology extending 4K video, USB 2.0, audio and control point to point up to 35m/115ft. The RX-500 still maintains the ability send HID’s and data back to the transmitter with USB 2.0 compatible devices such as HD webcams, smart white boards and data drives alike. Ideally suited for small meeting spaces and conference rooms, the RX-500 pairs perfectly with WyreStorm’s popular line of Presentation Solutions, such as the SW-130-TX or SW-510-TX to meet all of your presentation needs.

The main feature of the RX-500 is the 4 device ports, which are capable of USB 2.0 pass-through, which offers not only KVM functionality for extension of a keyboard/mouse or touchscreen, but also transfers the highest data rate that HDBaseT has to offer of 190Mbps, for webcams, white boards and USB data drives.

HDBaseT switcher/transmitter for video conference or meeting rooms

3 inputs and powerful HDBaseT transmission result is this powerful switching transmitter, perfect for corporate meeting and classroom environments. Automatic or manual switching of 2 HDMI’s or USB-C and CEC power triggering via HDBaseT mean a simple user experience when it matters most. Further functionality allows USB devices to be routed back to the source via USB host (or natively via USB-C) and charging for the connected USB-C device.

Setting a new standard for in-wall HDBaseT transmission, the SW-130-TX-US brings features of the WyreStorm range of professional switchers and packs them into a 2-gang form factor. Automatic or manual switching of the 3 connected sources (2 HDMI and USB-C) is possible with the USB-C supporting alt-mode functionality allowing a portable device such as a tablet or phone to be connected and send its content at up to 4K/30. HDCP 2.2 is also supported for the transmission of encrypted content.

It’s not all about the A/V when it comes to HDBaseT; with increased functionality on all fronts, the SW-130-TX can be used to send power triggers to a compatible connected screen, allowing centralized control and is PoH compatible meaning it can be passively powered over HDBaseT from a compatible receiver. The SW-130-TX can even power & charge a phone or tablet connected to the USB-C port so you don’t run out of juice mid-flow (max. 5v 2A)

The industry’s latest encryption standard designed to stop the illegal copying & distribution of 4K UHD content; no longer unique to residential solutions WyreStorm presentation switchers are fully compliant with HDCP 2.2, enabling you to de-centralize source devices within an installation.

HDBaseT2.0 affords the addition of USB 2.0 pass-through, offering not only KVM functionality for extension of a keyboard/mouse or touchscreen but also full data transfer capabilities. The SW-130-TX has a USB host port allowing USB device data to be routed into the selected laptop (via HDMI). Going further, it can send USB device data natively through the USB-C port allowing a single cable to be used for A/V and USB device connectivity.

3 inputs and powerful HDBaseT transmission result is this powerful switching transmitter, perfect for corporate meeting and classroom environments. Automatic or manual switching of 2 HDMI’s or USB-C and CEC power triggering via HDBaseT mean a simple user experience when it matters most. Further functionality allows USB devices to be routed back to the source via USB host (or natively via USB-C) and charging for the connected USB-C device.

Setting a new standard for in-wall HDBaseT transmission, the SW-130-TX-US brings features of the WyreStorm range of professional switchers and packs them into a 2-gang form factor. Automatic or manual switching of the 3 connected sources (2 HDMI and USB-C) is possible with the USB-C supporting alt-mode functionality allowing a portable device such as a tablet or phone to be connected and send its content at up to 4K/30. HDCP 2.2 is also supported for the transmission of encrypted content.

It’s not all about the A/V when it comes to HDBaseT; with increased functionality on all fronts, the SW-130-TX can be used to send power triggers to a compatible connected screen, allowing centralized control and is PoH compatible meaning it can be passively powered over HDBaseT from a compatible receiver. The SW-130-TX can even power & charge a phone or tablet connected to the USB-C port so you don’t run out of juice mid-flow (max. 5v 2A)

The industry’s latest encryption standard designed to stop the illegal copying & distribution of 4K UHD content; no longer unique to residential solutions WyreStorm presentation switchers are fully compliant with HDCP 2.2, enabling you to de-centralize source devices within an installation.

HDBaseT2.0 affords the addition of USB 2.0 pass-through, offering not only KVM functionality for extension of a keyboard/mouse or touchscreen but also full data transfer capabilities. The SW-130-TX has a USB host port allowing USB device data to be routed into the selected laptop (via HDMI). Going further, it can send USB device data natively through the USB-C port allowing a single cable to be used for A/V and USB device connectivity.
